summary: Added three ECS Fargate rules to cfn-lint: E3052 (FargateNetworkMode: Fargate TaskDefinition must use NetworkMode awsvpc; non-string values like !Ref are skipped), E3053 (FargatePrivileged: Fargate container definitions can't set Privileged true), and E3054 (FargateServiceNetworkConfiguration: Fargate Service requires NetworkConfiguration). Each has a JSON schema under data/schemas/extensions, a docs/rules.md row, and unit tests in test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/test_ecs_fargate_rules.py. ECS unit tests pass (68). Full suite: 1540 passed, 5 failed. The failures look environmental: junit and pygraphviz/pydot are missing, test_formatters.py can't import defusedxml, and two quickstart tests count 36 matches vs 35 on openshift.yaml, a template with no ECS resources (likely the date-dependent E2533 message, not verified on a clean baseline). Nothing is committed. The rule IDs are my own choice since the spec didn't name them and may differ from upstream.
